links.outcome: Summary accuracy and completeness with vs without prior sentence-level evidence tracking
links.effect: Explicit sentence-level tracking before summarization enhanced generation accuracy; adding full context further improved completeness. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: We also observe that explicitly performing sentence-level tracking prior to summarization enhances generation accuracy, while incorporating the full context further improves completeness.

unlisted_practices: Sentence-level citation traceability for aspect-based medical summaries

screen.reason: Introduces and evaluates a medical summarization benchmark specifically assessing sentence-level evidence citation/traceability to mitigate factual inaccuracy concerns.
